description: Extract a shared AiHtmlEditor client component (Code/Preview live preview with sandboxed iframe + an 'Iterate with AI' revise-in-place panel) and adopt it on all three existing builder surfaces: landing create, template create, and template edit. This gives the two template builders the live HTML preview they lack, adds iterate-with-AI everywhere, and makes all three look like one product. Landing-page EDIT CRUD is OUT OF SCOPE (no [id] route and no updateLandingPage exist). Depends on FEAT-001 (uses the currentHtml revision path).
steps: Create src/components/ai-html-editor.tsx ('use client'). Props: { kind: 'landing'|'email'; html: string; onHtmlChange: (v: string) => void; textareaName: string; textareaRequired?: boolean; starterHtml?: string }. Copy the landing studio editor markup from src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx verbatim in structure: a .landing-editor section containing .editor-tabs (Code2/Eye tab buttons toggling internal tab state 'code'|'preview'), the <textarea name={textareaName} value={html} onChange=>onHtmlChange> with className .studio-code (or 'hidden'), and the .studio-preview div holding <iframe title="Preview" srcDoc={html} sandbox="" />. KEEP sandbox="" exactly.

In the same component, render an 'Iterate with AI' panel reusing .landing-ai markup: .landing-ai-title (Sparkles) with helper copy (for kind==='email' mention the {{link}} tracking link is kept automatically), a file input (accept image/*, multiple) feeding an internal aiFiles File[] with removable .ai-files chips (X icon), a .field prompt textarea (aiPrompt), an inline {aiError && <div className="auth-message error">}, and a .button.secondary.ai-generate submit. Internal state: tab, aiPrompt, aiFiles, aiLoading, aiError.

Implement the panel submit: build FormData with prompt=aiPrompt, kind, each file under 'files', and when html is non-empty AND differs from starterHtml also append currentHtml=html. POST to /api/generate-content; on !res.ok set aiError from data.error; on success call onHtmlChange(data.html) and setTab('preview'). Button label logic: aiLoading ? (hasExistingHtml ? 'Revising…' : 'Generating…') : (hasExistingHtml ? 'Iterate with AI' : 'Generate with AI'). 'hasExistingHtml' = html is non-empty and not equal to starterHtml.

Refactor src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx: remove the inline .landing-editor section AND the inline .landing-ai generator sub-panel, and render <AiHtmlEditor kind="landing" html={html} onHtmlChange={setHtml} textareaName="htmlContent" textareaRequired starterHtml={starterHtml} /> in the editor column. Keep the .landing-studio/.landing-settings layout, name + urlSlug fields, the .studio-safety privacy block (safety copy — keep), createLandingPage submit, and starterHtml constant. Delete now-unused local AI state/handlers (files, aiPrompt, aiLoading, aiError, addFiles, removeFile, handleGenerate) and unused imports.

Refactor src/app/dashboard/templates/create/page.tsx: adopt the landing-studio two-column layout for consistency (wrap in .landing-studio with a .landing-settings column holding name + subject fields and the Save actions, and the editor column rendering <AiHtmlEditor kind="email" html={bodyHtml} onHtmlChange={setBodyHtml} textareaName="bodyHtml" textareaRequired starterHtml={emailStarterHtml} />). Define a small email starter constant (table-based, contains an href="{{link}}" CTA and 'credentials are NOT stored'-style safe copy) or reuse an empty string if simpler — but if empty, the first generate is from-scratch. Keep the createTemplate submit, name/subject field names, and the {{link}} helper note. Remove the old inline .landing-ai panel and the old plain bodyHtml textarea and now-unused AI state/handlers/imports.

Refactor src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/EditTemplateForm.tsx: replace the inline .landing-ai panel and plain bodyHtml textarea with <AiHtmlEditor kind="email" html={bodyHtml} onHtmlChange={setBodyHtml} textareaName="bodyHtml" textareaRequired />. Keep the hidden id input, name/subject defaultValue fields, the updateTemplate form action, and the SubmitButton. Because the loaded body_html is non-empty, iterate requests will send currentHtml (true revision). Remove now-unused AI state/handlers/imports. Match the create page's layout so create and edit look identical.

If the template pages adopt .landing-studio, ensure name/subject use .field markup (semantic classes) instead of the old Tailwind utility inputs so styling is consistent; do not leave a mix of utility-class and semantic inputs in the same studio column.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint && npm run build` pass clean.
src/components/ai-html-editor.tsx exists and is imported by landing create, template create, and template edit.
All three surfaces render a Code/Preview tab pair where Preview uses <iframe srcDoc={html} sandbox="" /> (sandbox attribute present and empty).
All three surfaces show an Iterate-with-AI panel; when HTML already exists the request includes currentHtml and the button reads 'Iterate with AI'/'Revising…'.
Template create and template edit no longer use ad-hoc Tailwind-utility form styling for the editor area; they use the shared component and semantic classes, matching the landing studio.
Safety copy and all save flows/field names (name, urlSlug, htmlContent, subject, bodyHtml, id) are unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run lint && npm run build`; confirm clean.
Grep the three surfaces to confirm each imports AiHtmlEditor and that no stale handleGenerate/local AI state remains (cleanup check, not the primary verification).
Read ai-html-editor.tsx to confirm the preview iframe has sandbox="" and the submit appends currentHtml only when existing HTML is present.
Record 'needs runtime verification' in findings: on each surface, generating/iterating updates the editor and switches to Preview; email revision preserves {{link}}; preview is sandboxed.
findings:
DONE. `npm run lint && npm run build` both pass clean.

SHARED COMPONENT: src/components/ai-html-editor.tsx (default export `AiHtmlEditor`, 'use client').
Prop signature:
  { kind: 'landing' | 'email'; html: string; onHtmlChange: (value: string) => void; textareaName: string; textareaRequired?: boolean; starterHtml?: string; initialTab?: 'code' | 'preview' }
- Renders the .landing-ai 'Iterate with AI' panel FOLLOWED BY the .landing-editor section (Code2/Eye tabs -> .studio-code textarea bound to html / .studio-preview iframe). Both live in the editor (right) column of .landing-studio on all three surfaces.
- Preview iframe: <iframe title="Preview" srcDoc={html} sandbox="" /> -- sandbox attribute present and empty (kept exactly).
- hasExistingHtml = html.trim().length > 0 && html !== (starterHtml ?? ''). When true, the generate FormData appends `currentHtml=html` (triggers FEAT-001 revision path) and the button label is 'Iterate with AI'/'Revising…'; otherwise 'Generate with AI'/'Generating…'. On success calls onHtmlChange(data.html) and switches tab to 'preview'.
- For kind==='email' the panel helper copy states the {{link}} tracking link is kept automatically.
- initialTab prop ADDED (default 'code') so a later feature can open the editor on Preview.

ADOPTED ON:
- src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx (kind="landing", textareaName="htmlContent", starterHtml={starterHtml}). Removed inline .landing-editor + .landing-ai and all local AI state/handlers/imports (tab, files, aiPrompt, aiLoading, aiError, addFiles, removeFile, handleGenerate, Code2/Eye/Sparkles/X icons). Kept .landing-studio/.landing-settings, name + urlSlug fields, .studio-safety privacy block, createLandingPage submit, starterHtml.
- src/app/dashboard/templates/create/page.tsx (kind="email", textareaName="bodyHtml", starterHtml={emailStarterHtml}). REWRITTEN to .landing-studio two-column layout with semantic .field inputs for name + subject (was ad-hoc Tailwind utilities). Added emailStarterHtml constant (table-based, href="{{link}}" CTA, 'No credentials are stored.' safe copy). Kept createTemplate submit + name/subject field names + {{link}} helper note (in .studio-safety).
- src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/EditTemplateForm.tsx (kind="email", textareaName="bodyHtml", NO starterHtml -> loaded body_html is non-empty so iterate always sends currentHtml = true revision). REWRITTEN to .landing-studio semantic layout matching create. Kept hidden id input, name/subject defaultValue fields, updateTemplate form action, SubmitButton. Its wrapper src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/edit/page.tsx was switched from Tailwind p-8 wrapper to .content-page/.page-heading to match create (back link uses .eyebrow).

FEAT-003 HANDOFF SEAM:
- The create pages own the html state (landing create: const [html,setHtml]=useState(starterHtml); template create: const [bodyHtml,setBodyHtml]=useState(emailStarterHtml)). A later useEffect in those create pages can seed html/bodyHtml from sessionStorage and pass initialTab="preview" to AiHtmlEditor to open on Preview. AiHtmlEditor does not own the html; it only lifts changes via onHtmlChange, so seeding from the parent is sufficient.

FIELD NAMES PRESERVED: name, urlSlug, htmlContent, subject, bodyHtml, id. Safety copy preserved (landing .studio-safety 'Do not request or store real credentials'; email starters say 'No credentials are stored.'; sandbox="" kept).

NEEDS RUNTIME VERIFICATION (not run here; requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY + live DashScope endpoint): on each surface generating/iterating updates the editor and switches to Preview; email revision preserves {{link}}; preview iframe is sandboxed. Also a light visual check: the .landing-ai panel now sits above the dark .landing-editor within the right studio column on all three surfaces (consistent across all three).
